notes: ProjectProfile contract · founder-authorised design 2026-09-12. DESCRIPTIVE · not prescriptive. Answers 'what does this project appear to be doing?' · never 'what should this project do?'. Every material inference has confidence + provenance. Read-only.

confidence_states.definition: the signal is directly present in a specific file · e.g. tsconfig.json declares strict:true
a large sample corroborates the signal · e.g. 84 of 90 sampled TS files use 2-space indentation
a small sample suggests the signal · e.g. 4 of 6 sampled files · flagged for caution
signals disagree · e.g. 50% tabs · 50% spaces · both counts recorded

required_top_level_fields.name: identity
required_top_level_fields.shape: object · project type · repository structure · primary/secondary languages · frameworks

required_top_level_fields.name: tooling
required_top_level_fields.shape: object · package manager · build · test · lint · formatter · type-checker

required_top_level_fields.name: style_signals
required_top_level_fields.shape: object · indentation · quotes · semicolons · naming (all with confidence + provenance)

required_top_level_fields.name: structure_signals
required_top_level_fields.shape: object · file location patterns · test naming patterns

required_top_level_fields.name: limitations
required_top_level_fields.shape: string · what the profile does NOT cover

per_signal_fields.name: value
per_signal_fields.shape: typed value or null when UNKNOWN

per_signal_fields.name: sample_size
per_signal_fields.shape: integer · how many files supported this signal

per_signal_fields.name: supporting_count
per_signal_fields.shape: integer · of sample_size · how many agreed

per_signal_fields.name: counter_count
per_signal_fields.shape: integer · of sample_size · how many disagreed

invariants: no signal is silently converted from UNKNOWN to a specific value
sample-based signals declare sample_size · supporting_count · counter_count
conflicting signals are enumerated · never silently resolved
profile is READ-ONLY · scanner writes nothing to the measured project
every material inference has evidence_files with sha256_prefix hashes
no universal style judgement · profile is DESCRIPTIVE only
generated/vendor classification reuses Code Intelligence rules where available · never creates a second contradictory definition
reused_from_code_intelligence: vendor_path_markers (node_modules · vendor · .venv · target · build · dist · .next · .nuxt · __pycache__ · .cargo · third_party · third-party)
special_basenames (Makefile · Dockerfile · package.json · tsconfig.json · pyproject.toml · Cargo.toml · go.mod · etc.)
language registry v0.1.0 (44 languages · extensions · shebangs · special filenames)
